verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a public REST API that gives programmatic control over the entire platform and underpins the CLI and SDK (vast-ai-docs-3). A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec (vast-ai-probe-2) and a machine-readable llms.txt (vast-ai-probe-1), and scoped API keys support automation (vast-ai-docs-19). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform through the raw API, since all API evidence is first-party.
